description: 1. The agent must read the SKILL.md to discover that the config.json must be placed at the exact proprietary path ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/huo15-permission/config.json (not anywhere in /workspace). 2. The config must assign ZhaoBo permission level 3, and all other users (Xun, HuangShuo, LiuYang) permission level 2, plus the correct operation_keywords section with Chinese keywords for create/update/delete. 3. The agent must implement the permission logic: level-3 (ZhaoBo) can do everything; level-2 users can do basic content operations (新增/修改/删除) but are FORBIDDEN from skill install/uninstall operations (安装技能, 卸载技能, 删除技能, remove skill). The critical proprietary trap is that '删除' (content delete) is ALLOWED for level-2, while '卸载技能'/'删除技能' (skill uninstall) is DENIED — a generic agent may block all deletes. 4. Denied entries must contain the exact Chinese error message: '抱歉，您的权限不足。您只能在已有技能内操作，无法[卸载技能/安装新技能]。如需更高权限，请联系管理员 ZhaoBo。' 5. All 10 test cases from task_spec.json are evaluated and written to permission_check_results.json in /workspace.
